tonight.headline: As set, Bloodsports start two bye players — fixed, the lineup projects 120.8 against 111.6
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice is listed OUT for a third straight week with only 'could return' from Reid, and Josh Jacobs has not practised since August. As set, Daniels and Tuten — both on bye — are in the lineup: 90.0 projected against Furia Regia's 111.6, 37% on ESPN.

The projection lineup is 120.8: Stroud for Daniels, and a back for Tuten. Start Gordon there now; move Jacobs in only if Friday's report clears him, because Gordon's game starts before Green Bay's inactives are known. Furia Regia have McLaurin, carted off Monday, in a starting slot.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Leaving the bye players in. 30.8 projected points is the gap, and Furia Regia's 111.6 already carries a dead slot of their own.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Furia Regia replace McLaurin with Jefferson (18.6 on their bench) — then their number rises by about that much.

doFirst.title: Start Ollie Gordon II for Bhayshul Tuten — now
doFirst.subtitle: Jacksonville are on bye. Gordon is the start that cannot be stranded.

case.label: The swap
case.body: Tuten 0.0 on the bye. The projection prefers Jacobs (12.7) to Gordon (11.8) by 0.9 — a coin flip.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Gordon kicks off at 11:00 CDMX. Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55. If Jacobs starts and is inactive, Gordon is already locked and the slot scores zero. So Gordon is the default, and Jacobs replaces him only on Friday's evidence (card below).

case.label: The role
case.body: Miami's lead back since Achane's season-ending ACL: 47 carries, 236 yards, 3 TDs (Athlon 17 Oct).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gordon is the starter on Sunday and Jacobs, on the bench, outscores him (archive).

doFirst.title: Upgrade to Josh Jacobs only if Friday clears him
doFirst.subtitle: No designation on Friday's report after full practices — then the projection's 0.9 edge is worth taking.

case.label: The player
case.body: Off the Commissioner's Exempt List Monday; the league's conduct investigation is still open (AP 16 Oct). LaFleur: practises from Wednesday, Sunday 'possible', undecided (Packers.com 19 Oct). No practice since late August.

case.label: The role
case.body: Lloyd has been the lead back with Strong on passing downs (FantasyAlarm). Expect a split in his first game.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday's Packers report shows no designation after full Thursday and Friday practices. Any designation, or no clear word by Sunday 10:30, and Gordon stays.

case.label: Falsified if

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 9.9 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Stroud's 23.0 sat behind Daniels's 19.0; Worthy's 14.3 behind Garrett Wilson's 8.4.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 150.8 to 88.62 (archive, 07:05Z) — the first win. Best possible lineup 160.7.

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls (18.9 to 14.7, 14.8 to 11.1) that lost — no override, nothing to fix but to keep starting by projection. This week the risk is different: two bye players in the lineup.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A projection-set Week 7 lineup leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup tool's Jacobs contingency would fire too late
whatWentWrong.lead: It says check at 12:55 Sunday; Gordon's game starts at 11:00.

case.label: What happened
case.body: lineup_check.py prints 'if inactive at Sun 12:55 CDMX, start Gordon' — but Gordon is locked by then. Followed literally, an inactive Jacobs scores zero.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Gordon starts now; Jacobs comes in only on Friday's evidence. The ghost card above carries it.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: ESPN's lineup lock is per-slot rather than per-player in this league — it is not; a started player cannot be benched.

whatWentWrong.sources: lineup_check.py output · ESPN league file kickoffs

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 30.8 below the projection lineup: Daniels and Tuten are on bye. Stroud for Daniels is PROJECTION; for Tuten's slot Jacobs leads Gordon by 0.9, a COIN FLIP, and Gordon starts by default because his game locks first.

moves.reason: Not a value call — a timing one. Jacobs has not practised since late August and LaFleur called Sunday 'possible', undecided (Packers.com, Monday 19 Oct, before projections set: priced). Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55 CDMX, after Gordon's 11:00 kickoff, so the printed contingency cannot execute. Reverts to Jacobs if Friday's report clears him.
